title: 社会保険労務士法の施行について
locator: 記 第二 四・五
coverage: Original official historical definitions of excluded treatment-provider claims and professional qualification scope.
scopeAssessment: Partial historical evidence only. The old general statement excluding representation precedes the 1986 representation amendment and cannot establish the 2026 withdrawal/receipt rules. The exact special-consultant settlement acceptance/rejection notice and the 1986 current procedural interpretation remain unacquired.
